text: anya: Quick design review request — putting the 'Access Board' compact view into the invite flow. Wanted feedback on copy, affordances, and a11y before I hand to eng. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood.app/file/xyz maya: looked at the mock. love the dense rows, but a few concerns: the role chips feel ambiguous when inheritance is present (parent vs direct). sam: +1 on ambiguity. From an implementation POV we should avoid adding an extra API call to compute inherited reasons on hover. Prefer inline hint text that we can compute on the client from the existing membership tree. oli: FYI calculating full inheritance for 500 users in a single org could still be heavy if we render it all at once. can we virtualize the rows and only expand inheritance details on demand? kevin: accessibility nits: keyboard focus order breaks when the compact row reveals the kebab menu. Also color contrast on the "SSO enforced" pill is 2.9:1 on the current purple. Needs to hit 4.5:1 for small text. maya: good catch. Proposal: use a filled outline for enforced state (dark navy bg + white text) and add an icon with aria-label "SSO required" so screen readers don't rely on color alone. anya: copy question — on the invite modal, we currently show "Grant role" vs "Assign role" in different places. Which verb is clearer? sam: I prefer "Assign role" for the act of giving a person access, "Grant" feels more permission-y and less consistent across the UI. kevin: also call out focus-visible for the role chips. Add aria-pressed on toggles and a visually-hidden label: `roleName + ", collapsible, press space to expand"`. maya: small microcopy tweak for inherited badge: change from "Inherited via team: X" to "Via team: X (inherits this role)" — keeps it shorter on mobile. oli: about the audit log link — the new compact row has a tiny timestamp. We should add a single action inline: "View audit" that routes to audit?filters=entity=user:id. That avoids context switching in most cases. anya: ok — decision checklist: 1) compact rows keep virtualization + on-demand inheritance; 2) change verb to "Assign role"; 3) SSO pill colors and icon + aria-label; 4) add "View audit" inline action; 5) update inherited badge copy to maya suggestion. anyone object? sam: fine from me. i'll do the frontend estimation after final assets. kevin: happy with those as long as dev follows the aria suggestions. can we add a quick code snippet in the doc? maya: here's a minimal pattern we can use — put the snippet in the component doc: ``` Via infra ``` kevin: perfect. Also recommend `role-chip:focus { outline-offset: 3px }` and to ensure focus-visible isn't removed by custom styles. anya: thanks all. i'll update the figma labels and the spec doc with the checklist. target: get dev PR on staging by EOD Friday. tagging @sam and @oli to coordinate. :calendar: :rocket: ux-bot: Note: added thread to design-review board and created task #DR-1145 for follow-up. maya: one last tiny nit — mobile truncation: truncate inherited badge after 12 chars and show tooltip on long-press. otherwise looks good. oli: noted. will include virtualization + tooltip handling in the estimate. anya: sweet — closing this thread. if anything blocks, reopen. :thumbsup:
